principles.title: Purpose
principles.acceptance: The responsibility has a meaningful user outcome and stays focused on the problem it exists to solve.
principles.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Improvement is accepted only when it advances the responsibility purpose.

principles.title: Agency
principles.acceptance: People remain informed and in control, can choose how to proceed, and can recover from mistakes.
principles.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Improvement preserves user authority, recovery, and explicit persistent-change boundaries.

principles.title: Responsibility
principles.acceptance: The responsibility acts in people’s best interests with safety, privacy, transparency, and data minimisation.
principles.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Improvement evidence must prove benefit without weakening safety, privacy, or trust.

principles.title: Familiarity
principles.acceptance: The responsibility uses consistent concepts, clear feedback, and established Fractal language.
principles.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Improvement extends maintained concepts instead of creating needless parallel systems.

principles.title: Flexibility
principles.acceptance: The responsibility works across relevant people, contexts, access needs, inputs, and platforms while preserving context.
principles.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Improvement is tested against diverse real conditions and does not narrow supported access.

principles.title: Simplicity
principles.acceptance: The responsibility is clear, direct, concise, and hierarchically organised, including only what the job needs.
principles.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Improvement removes avoidable burden while retaining necessary evidence and control.

principles.title: Craft
principles.acceptance: The responsibility demonstrates quality in details, real-world testing, iteration, reliability, and maintenance after release.
principles.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Craft makes evidence-led iteration and ongoing maintenance inseparable from completion.

principles.title: Delight
principles.acceptance: The complete experience creates a purposeful human moment rather than superficial decoration.
principles.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Improvement must preserve purposeful human value and receive qualitative human acceptance.

cross_cutting_requirements.title: Generative AI
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance: AI behavior is transparent, controllable, bounded, recoverable, and evaluated for useful output and foreseeable harm.
cross_cutting_requirements.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: AI is an instrument of evidenced Continuous Improvement and never substitutes for user authority or System Review.

cross_cutting_requirements.title: Accessibility
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance: The responsibility is perceivable, understandable, adaptable, and operable through every relevant access modality from the start.
cross_cutting_requirements.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Each review checks that improvements preserve or expand effective access.

cross_cutting_requirements.title: Inclusion
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance: Language, assumptions, defaults, and evaluation account for diverse people and contexts without stereotyping or exclusion.
cross_cutting_requirements.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Reality checks include affected perspectives and use findings to correct exclusion.

cross_cutting_requirements.title: Privacy
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance: Collect, retain, expose, and transmit only necessary data with clear purpose, protection, consent, and control.
cross_cutting_requirements.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Improvement evidence cannot be purchased by expanding data access beyond the job.

cross_cutting_requirements.title: Writing
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance: User-facing language is clear, conversational, concise, consistent, actionable, and written for people rather than internal architecture.
cross_cutting_requirements.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Reviews treat comprehension failures as product evidence and correct the maintained language.

cross_cutting_requirements.title: Feedback and status
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance: Every consequential action communicates state, result, errors, and the next available action at the right time.
cross_cutting_requirements.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Observable outcomes make success and failure usable as review evidence.

cross_cutting_requirements.title: Undo and recovery
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance: People can cancel, undo, restore, or safely recover from mistakes and interrupted work in proportion to risk.
cross_cutting_requirements.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Experiments and corrections retain a tested restoration path.

cross_cutting_requirements.title: Loading and progress
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance: Waiting work is responsive, bounded where possible, honest about progress, and never presented as complete before evidence exists.
cross_cutting_requirements.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Latency and stalled progress are measured evidence for the next improvement.

cross_cutting_requirements.title: Offering help
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance: Contextual help appears where a person needs it, explains the next action, and does not compensate for an avoidably unclear primary path.
cross_cutting_requirements.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Repeated help needs feed Perspective and System Review rather than becoming permanent friction.

cross_cutting_requirements.title: Continuous Improvement core
cross_cutting_requirements.acceptance: Apple alignment operates only as System Review acceptance; Perspective and System Review remain the single continuous-improvement path and no parallel lifecycle is created.
cross_cutting_requirements.continuous_improvement_reinforcement: Purpose, evidence-led iteration, real-world testing, and maintenance strengthen the existing Fractal core.
